title: Medical Certificate — Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB
publisher: La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB
claims: A medical certificate for competitive sports activity is mandatory for all race distances under Italian law.

Non-Italian athletes must provide a certificate under Italian law (DM 18/02/1982) or the downloadable form; it must be no more than 12 months old at issue, uploaded to the personal dashboard between 10 January 2027 and 15 May 2027, and valid on 27 June 2027.
Italian athletes resident abroad must upload a certificate for competitive practice of athletics under DM 18/02/1982 in the same window, valid on 27 June 2027.
Italian athletes must upload a competitive medical certificate valid on 27 June 2027 in the same window.
Failure to upload the certificate by the deadline permanently cancels the registration without refund.
